title: Meeting follow-up
description: Paste your notes or upload a transcript to turn a meeting into clear decisions and next steps.
example:
Decision: continue the pilot for one more week.
Action: confirm the revised timetable — owner and deadline not recorded.
Follow-up: a short draft message summarizing the decisions and next steps.

Illustrative example; actions must be supported by your notes.
